post.description:
Accepts either JSON (`FileUploadJsonRequest` with `content_base64`) or `multipart/form-data`.
Validates file extension, MIME type, magic bytes, and size, stores binary outside PostgreSQL,
and records metadata in `public.file_metadata`.

Controlled payment reversal (Sections 6.3 & 10.6):
Preserves the original payment row, reverses active invoice allocations,
cancels active receipt allocations (and marks linked finalized receipts as cancelled/refunded),
and transitions the payment to `'reversed'`.

Generates an official finalized receipt acknowledging a confirmed payment (or portion thereof).
- Idempotent: if the exact full payment has already been receipted and `amount_acknowledged` is omitted,
  or if `Idempotency-Key` matches, protects against duplicate receipt creation.
- Enforces at both service and PostgreSQL trigger levels that unconfirmed payments can never be receipted
  and no payment amount can be acknowledged more than once.

Increments `print_count` without creating another payment or receipt record.
Marks `is_duplicate_copy = True` when `print_count > 1`.

get.description:
Authoritative Revenue & Collections Report (Section 10.12 & Section 14).
Separates billed invoice value, confirmed cash payments, refunds, net collections,
and receipt acknowledgments without ever double-counting payments and receipts.
